subject: Publish the interactive annual land-cover page on the ImintEngine showcase
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-02 to publish the interactive annual land-cover map (the IM-024 municipality demo, task 0128) on the ImintEngine showcase together with Codex, and approved a public, unauthenticated API for it. Scope: the static page (docs/lclu.html, docs/js/lclu.js, docs/css/lclu.css, docs/js/lclu-config.js with apiBase https://lclu.icedc.se) and its link from the Marktäcke tab; k8s/lclu-public.yaml with a Service pinned to the campaign Job lclu-stockholm-0124-r8 and an Ingress on lclu.icedc.se that exposes only the /v1/lclu prefix, with TLS (letsencrypt-prod), CORS for the exact origin https://tobiasedman.github.io and a per-IP rate limit; tests for those properties; a short note on the public surface. The cluster objects are applied only after r8 serves all 88 qualified area-years and the manifest has a Codex PASS. Not in scope: the service code itself (it runs from the 0128 branch bundle and needs its own PR), deleting r7, authentication. Review: Codex.
